main_text.l: eo exemplari usus fuerit. Domino
Cramoisy mitto indicem librorum Græco-
rum, qvi penes me sunt, qvos tuo arbi-
tratu cum aliis ab ipso editis commuta-
bo: rem totam plenius ex ipsis literis
perspicies. Cum Dominis Puteanis
velim agas de Vitis Pontificum, qvas paro;
& præsertim de Anastasio bibliothe-
cario, cujus exemplar Parisiis extare a-junt, ab edito longe diversum.
Reverendissimo P. Sirmendo qvam commen-
datissima esse cupio studia mea, cui id
velim persvadeas, me nomini ipsius esse addictissimum
[?]: id qvoqve perqviras, num Anastasii Sinaitæ opera græca Ma-
nuscripta meo sumptu atqve ære hic
transcripta, Domino Cramoisy tradita
fuerint. Nollem enim perire, uti etiam
collationes Hoseæ Prophetæ ad antiqvis-
simum exemplar Barberinæ bibliothec-
æ à me institutas, qvas P. Philippæo tra-
dendas miseram: plura tempus vetat,
tu amantem redama, & rem feliciter
gere: sic tibi iter, qvod paras, cæte-

page.notes: An ink blot covers part of "addictissimum" (the "ss" area), so that word is marked [?]. The word at the line end "a-junt" is printed with a hyphen after "a" and is kept as printed. The catchword "raqve" is at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
